trip_charge_v1.energy_impact: Read-only before-next-free-window estimate for the native Trip request or the validated standard legacy helper plan, with explicit source/scope/status/time, remaining pack/wall energy, before/during/after-free energy, battery surplus after configured floor and existing house forecast once, incremental paid-energy liability and configured-tariff cost bounds. Missing/invalid/out-of-scope costs are null, not free. No current battery pool is carried through free charging, no later cost or retailer payment is implied, and no value grants control authority.
